{% autoescape off %}# Floorball Scanner

> Floorball Scanner is a web-based analytics platform for floorball coaches: live expected
> goals (xG), shot maps, and team/line/player performance data. Built by two former Finnish
> Elite-league players and analytics coaches.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://fbscanner.io/): overview of the platform and its features.
- [F-Liiga](https://fbscanner.io/f-liiga/): live F-Liiga match tracking, xG, shot maps, team
  and player statistics, and a 0-100 player performance Rating.

## Blog

Articles explaining floorball analytics (expected goals, GSAx, and other KPIs) and how coaches
can use match data in practice.

- [{{ post.title }}](https://fbscanner.io/blog/{{ post.slug }}/): {{ post.excerpt }}
